not_covered.text: The Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and Joint Forces repels a major assault by Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on the Jebrat al Sheikh district in North Kordofan, Sudan.
Renewed drone attacks by the RSF are reported in Khartoum, Sudan, for a second consecutive day, with the SAF intercepting several drones targeting the area.

Greece's public health agency reports 110 West Nile virus infections and nine deaths in 2026, including 45 new cases in one week, as authorities increase mosquito-control measures in the Athens metropolitan area.
